net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.FixedSizeThumbnailMaker maker = new net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.FixedSizeThumbnailMaker(50, 50);
net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.ThumbnailMaker returnedMaker = maker.defaultResizer();

assert returnedMaker == maker : "Expected fluent return of the same ThumbnailMaker instance";

java.awt.image.BufferedImage result = returnedMaker.make(sourceImage);

assert result != null : "Resulting image should not be null";
assert result.getWidth() <= 50 && result.getHeight() <= 50 : "Image should fit within 50x50";
assert result.getWidth() == 50 || result.getHeight() == 50 : "At least one dimension should be exactly 50";

System.out.println("__CHECK__ defaultResizer " + result.getWidth() + "x" + result.getHeight());
